name: Paribus pETH redeem reentrancy
summary: PEther.redeemFresh sent ether to the redeemer before reducing its pETH balance and totalSupply, so the receive hook re-entered the comptroller and borrowed from other markets against pETH collateral that was being withdrawn. The attacker supplied ETH and USDT, borrowed, then redeemed and borrowed USDT and WBTC inside the callback.
notes: The pETH delegator was created already pointing at the vulnerable implementation; the comptroller set pETH's collateral factor shortly afterwards. Borrowing against pETH needed that HIGH-rated setting (rule 8), so it, not the deployment, is the reset.

USDT is the gross amount borrowed from pUSDT: the 30,000 USDT the attacker supplied as collateral and left in the market is not subtracted (rule 11). The 200 ETH the attacker supplied to pETH and redeemed within the transaction is excluded.
